summary: Iteration 3 full-stack test of E-KERTALANGU: CSV/XLSX bulk import, DD-MM-YYYY DateField picker, and activation second-factor (DOB). Backend: 23/23 pytest tests pass (/app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py) covering CSV import (header skip, DOB normalization 17-08-1970 -> 1970-08-17, dedup via 'skipped'), xlsx import (string + real date cells), unsupported .pdf -> 400 Indonesian message, admin-only guard (401 anon), new {entries:[{name,dob}]} payload (old {names:[...]} correctly 422), activation/search requires_dob flag true/false, second factor 403 'Tanggal lahir tidak sesuai' on wrong DOB + 200/active+cookies with correct DOB (both ISO and DD-MM-YYYY accepted), pending-without-DOB activates with any DOB, invalid ObjectId -> 400, all 3 seeded logins, bcrypt $2b$ hash, httpOnly cookies, app-level CORS allow-credentials + explicit origin, brute-force lockout after 5 fails (429) and cleared by self-reset, self-reset blocked for multi-role (403), pending-account login 401 (not 500). Perf: 300-row CSV import completed in 0.35s. Frontend (Playwright, public URL): admin panel elements + DD-MM-YYYY hint, textarea add 'Uji Satu, 01-01-1980' -> success toast + 'Menunggu Aktivasi' badge, CSV file import via input-import-file -> toast + names in list, DateField opens calendar popover and displays 15-03-1975 / 01-01-1980 / 17-08-1970 correctly on Register / Activate / Login-reset, full public registration -> /roles, activation dob-verify-note shown, wrong DOB -> error toast and stays on /activate, correct DOB -> activated and logged in, self-reset via picker then login with new password works, role dashboard shows only owned roles. All test-created users deleted; seeded Peserta password restored to Peserta#2026 and all 3 seeded logins verified 200.

minor.issue: Unparseable DOB strings (e.g. '17 Agustus 1970') are silently normalized to null - the row is created with no DOB and the response gives no 'invalid_dates' feedback, so the admin never learns the second factor was dropped.

dob is stored raw (body.dob.strip()) without normalize_dob(), unlike /pending and /import. An admin-created pending user with dob '17-08-1970' would store DD-MM-YYYY and then fail the activation second factor. Same for POST /api/auth/register (raw dob) and the fallback at /activation/complete (or body.dob.strip()).
Dedup only checks {name, status: 'pending'}; a name that already exists as an ACTIVE user is re-created as a new pending duplicate.
No upload size / row-count guard; whole file is read into memory and each row does an individual find_one+insert_one (N+1). Fine at 300 rows (0.35s) but unbounded.
Lockout clear uses delete_many({'email': user['email']}); for users whose email is null this would delete login_attempts of unrelated null-email users.

design_issues.screen: DateField calendar popover (all screens: input-reg-dob, input-act-dob, input-new-dob, input-reset-dob)
issues: react-day-picker 'dropdown-buttons' caption is unstyled/duplicated: the caption label ('Agustus 1970') renders on top of the dropdowns, the a11y 'Month:'/'Year:' labels and the stray selected-value text ('Agustus', '1970') are visible, and the prev/next nav arrows overlap the two selects. Looks broken and is not elderly-friendly. Fix components/ui/calendar.jsx classNames (hide caption_label when captionLayout is dropdown, add caption_dropdowns/dropdown/vhidden styles) or use captionLayout='dropdown' with proper shadcn styling.

Popover opens downward and covers the following form fields / submit button (e.g. covers 'Kata Sandi Baru' + Simpan in the reset dialog, and the 'Buat Akun' button in the admin panel) until a date is chosen; consider align/side collision handling.

action_items: Style the shadcn Calendar dropdown caption (hide duplicate caption label / a11y label text, stop nav-arrow overlap) - only user-visible defect found.

Apply normalize_dob() consistently in POST /api/admin/users, POST /api/auth/register and the /activation/complete fallback so stored DOBs are always ISO and the second factor cannot be bypassed/broken by a DD-MM-YYYY value.
Return invalid/unparseable date rows in the import response (e.g. 'invalid_dates') so the admin knows which rows lost their DOB.
Optionally dedupe imports against active users too, and add a row/size cap on the import upload.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: DOB normalization is applied in build_pending_doc/import/activation but NOT in admin_create_user or register - inconsistent write path for the same field used as an auth second factor.
admin_import_users performs per-row await find_one + insert_one; use a single $in lookup + insert_many for large files.
self_reset clears brute-force attempts by email while login locks by user id; works today only because attempt docs store both, and breaks for null-email users.
